summary_zh:
Hverir 位於Námafjall山腳，可近距離觀看冒煙噴氣孔、沸騰泥漿池及多彩礦物地表。地殼可能薄弱且溫度極高, 這裡濃濃地熱散發出來的氣味，別有特色的地質公園。

停車場不大，出入口分開，離開前記得 Parka 繳費。

這裡不大，只有一條路，保留 60 分鐘時間可以好好的走上一圈。
summary_en: Hverir, located at the foot of Námafjall, offers close-up views of smoking fumaroles, boiling mud pots, and colorful mineral surfaces. Parking is limited, paid, and the entrance and exit are separate, so be sure to pay at the parkas before leaving. There are no restroom facilities on site. Allocate about 60 minutes to walk the short trail and fully explore the area. The site is part of the Diamond Circle and can be reached via Route 1 in Northeast Iceland.
